entries.title: Psalms 38:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance.>> O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

entries.title: Psalms 38:2
segments: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.

entries.title: Psalms 38:3
segments: [There is] no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither [is there any] rest in my bones because of my sin. {rest: Heb. peace, or, health}

entries.title: Psalms 38:4
segments: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:5
segments: My wounds stink [and] are corrupt because of my foolishness.

entries.title: Psalms 38:6
segments: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long. {troubled: Heb. wried}

entries.title: Psalms 38:7
segments: For my loins are filled with a loathsome [disease]: and [there is] no soundness in my flesh.

entries.title: Psalms 38:8
segments: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 38:9
segments: Lord, all my desire [is] before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.

entries.title: Psalms 38:10
segments: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me. {is gone...: Heb. is not with me}

words.text: from me. {is gone...: Heb. is not with me}

entries.title: Psalms 38:11
segments: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off. {sore: Heb. stroke} {my kinsmen: or, my neighbours}

words.text: . {sore: Heb. stroke} {my kinsmen: or, my neighbours}

entries.title: Psalms 38:12
segments: ¶They also that seek after my life lay snares [for me]: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

entries.title: Psalms 38:13
segments: But I, as a deaf [man], heard not; and [I was] as a dumb man [that] openeth not his mouth.

words.text: not; and [I was] as a dumb man

entries.title: Psalms 38:14
segments: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth [are] no reproofs.

words.text: Thus I was as a man

entries.title: Psalms 38:15
segments: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God. {in...: or, thee do I wait for} {hear: or, answer}

words.text: . {in...: or, thee do I wait for} {hear: or, answer}

entries.title: Psalms 38:16
segments: For I said, [Hear me], lest [otherwise] they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify [themselves] against me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:17
segments: For I [am] ready to halt, and my sorrow [is] continually before me. {to halt: Heb. for halting}

words.text: before me. {to halt: Heb. for halting}

entries.title: Psalms 38:18
segments: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

entries.title: Psalms 38:19
segments: But mine enemies [are] lively, [and] they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied. {are lively...: Heb. being living, are strong}

words.text: . {are lively...: Heb. being living, are strong}

entries.title: Psalms 38:20
segments: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow [the thing that] good [is].

entries.title: Psalms 38:21
segments: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:22
segments: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation. {to...: Heb. for my help}
